description: Land Title Settlement Department - Magalle, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District  - Cad. Map No.819912 and other land settlements
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and encumbrances) in the Galle district. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
